title: VNG Realisatie sets the architecture every Dutch municipal supplier must conform to
content:
VNG Realisatie belongs to the association of Dutch municipalities and owns Common Ground and the FSC standard. That ownership is the claim: every supplier selling into Dutch municipal government has to conform to an architecture this body defines.

It follows that VNG is an influence target rather than a delivery channel. Winning a project with a supplier affects one municipality; affecting what Common Ground or FSC requires affects the constraint every supplier in the market builds against. That is the highest-leverage and the slowest position available in the Dutch track.

It also explains why several other Dutch entries in this set are valuable partly through their proximity to this body — co-developing standards with VNG recurs as a qualifying signal. The priority-3 placement reflects the length of the cycle rather than the size of the prize.
